verdict.rationale: ByteAsk's docs say it 'reads your codebase' and 'edits your repository from the terminal' as part of its agentic loop, implying it can traverse code without the user pre-selecting files, but there is no explicit feature for mapping/explaining an entire unfamiliar codebase (no semantic search, indexing, or codebase-summary capability documented). Missing for 10: explicit codebase-mapping/summarization feature, evidence of handling large/unfamiliar repos without manual file selection, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this specific capability.
